items.title: Spreading geometric irreducibility from a geometrically irreducible generic fibre to a nonempty open of the base
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: Given a finite type morphism of schemes whose generic fibre over the generic point of an irreducible base is geometrically irreducible, one must produce a single nonempty open of the base over which every fibre is geometrically irreducible. The retained first proof is constructive: it first shrinks so the generic fibre is geometrically reduced, then builds an explicit finite type model B' = A[x_1,...,x_{r+1}]/(P) of the generic point from a separating transcendence basis and the minimal polynomial, compares the original scheme and the model on common dense opens, and finishes by a density shrinking argument. The model construction and the birational comparison are the load-bearing steps, and the author states a second independent proof, showing the result is not routine. Retained author proof at lines 7569-7641.
